description: Use this when the user asks about a company in Switzerland, Austria or Germany: whether it exists or is still registered, its legal form, UID or Firmenbuch number, seat or former name, or when they want companies of a trade in a town, postcode, canton or Bundesland they name. It searches the FIRMEN.directory company directory: commercial-register entries for Switzerland (Zefix) and Austria (Firmenbuch), plus listings maintained by business owners in Switzerland, Austria and Germany. Each result has company-level facts (legal form, UID or Firmenbuch number, seat, trade), a link to the profile and the id for get_company. Listings maintained by the owner also carry the owner's short description; results may carry an average star rating with the number of reviews, and the distance for searches near the user. Do not use it to find persons, owners or officers, for contact details of register entries, for insolvency or deletion lists, or for credit information: the directory has none of these.

country.description: Restrict to one country when the user names it.

name.description: Company name or part of it, at least 3 letters, e.g. "Muster Treuhand".

near_user.description: True only when the user asks for companies near them and names no place. The coarse location the host provides is used; never ask the user for coordinates.

place.description: Town or postcode of the company's seat, e.g. "Frauenfeld", "Zürich" or "8400": the town under its local name in Latin letters, whatever language the user writes in ("Zürich" for "Zurigo", "Genève" for "Ginevra"). This is the search area, not the user's own location.

region.description: Swiss canton (name or code, e.g. "Thurgau", "TG"), Austrian Bundesland (e.g. "Tirol") or German Land, when the user names one.

trade.description: Trade or line of business as a German word, e.g. "Elektriker", "Treuhand", "Restaurant". Translate it when the user writes in another language: "Sanitär" for "plumber", "plombier" or "idraulico".

name: search_companies
title: Search companies
